content.contents: i sincerely hope you didn't click on this blog hoping to find a link to a static.discord.server, because you'll be sorely disappointed. why?

i have absolutely no desire to make such a server. i know people recommend it because it's a good way to interact with your audience and fans and shit, and yeah, i agree, but i also think it's so much responsibility what with safeguarding and dealing with assholes and the setup and everything, i don't know, it just doesn't appeal all that much, if at all...

i also don't think i'm anywhere near popular enough to warrant the creation of such a server so to me, it's just not of interest! if people want to reach out to me there's many other ways they can do so.

incidentally, i do have a *private* discord server but it's just a hangout spot for friends, nothing more. and, in honesty, i'd prefer to keep it that way! it's fun to just chill. given the fact that in the niche circle i move around i've already found some miniscule pockets of hatred over who i am, i also don't want ot run the risk of people suffering me their incessant, benign bullshit. so, it probably won't happen, not unless i get bigger and can put together a team to run it for me.

there's some things i like the idea of though, like running a minecraft server or something. but you know how minecraft servers go. two weeks of hardcore building and two years of pure stagnation. that boom-bust cycle is palpable and it seems to be kind of futile to open one, because you're basically burning $10 or however much a month on a doomed-to-be ghost town.
incidentally, i do have a *private* minecraft realm, but it's again, a hangout spot for friends, and has indeed suffered the same ghosting fate.

i finished Pokemon Ultra Sun recently - that is to say, beat the elite four and team 'rainbow rocket'. i've gotta say, the team rainbow rocket girl grunts are cute, i love their hair. the pokemon team sure know how to draw 'em.

oh, on top of the album coming out in January, i've got another compilation in the works of a bunch of tracks. we'll see when it comes out but i'm excited for it. i think it'll be good! i've got quite an array of tracks built up in a backlog, so we'll see when i'm keen to chuck it all out. i've written a lot of miscellanious material that i'm happy with. here, i'll chuck some unused artwork in here:
was going to be used for the track 'fivestar chikin', which has yet to be released under that title and outside of soundcloud.

used for one track on soundcloud, so technically not 'unused', but it was going to be a cover for an EP. alas, i no longer wish to use this title or artwork, so here it will remain. some two or three of you who read this may wonder, what is F.S. RECORDS? it is essentially a term for my releases, and collaborative releases with friends. no, i don't own a label, and unless i had a lot of money i don't think i'd like to.

too many times have i seen artists try and 'start labels' with no funding and no ideas about music marketing and promo, and it all falls flat after 6 months to a year. it just seems pointless, y'know? people can easily use distrokid and shit!

i'm into this weird monochrome artwork at the moment. i'm not sure why. i guess i just like how easy it is to make and how good the contrast looks? when something is so minimalist as this it means there's much less margin for error. hell, i suppose as long as your mind remains open, there *is* no error margin within the realm of art. but you know what they say, sometimes you can open your mind so much it falls out. sometimes i hear these idioms though and i feel they're so vague they're maybe, more often than not used for nefarious purposes.

it's like how politicians love to tout 'common sense' as a fundamental of their campaign, or the pursuit of truth or what have you. i mean, truth is defined by the individual, and it's different from fact. even then, facts and truth can both develop and evolve as culture does, and social culture evolves incredibly fast, so when we speak to such concepts as common sense or an unequivocal, irrevocable and solitary truth, we're only really speaking to something that those who live comfortably in the majority can lean into with ease. i suppose that's why it resonates so well with the masses. in order for social evolution to develop, though, humans must remain to ebb against the flow. what is art if not politics? a banana duct-taped to a wall may not be art, but it sure does get people talking about the boundaries in which we define art. humans are beautiful but fickle in this way!

today i had coffee and monster. hoo, lots of caffeine. a great time though, really. i love both. i was going to have a decaf but decided last minute to have caffeine, because hey, why the fuck not? right?
not much else for ol' static girl to report. i hope you're all having a wonderful time.
